en: Black‑and‑white view of a long, slightly rising street lined with two‑ to three‑storey townhouses and small shops. On the left corner is a rough‑plastered house with dormer windows and a steep tiled roof. Farther along the left side are shopfronts with German lettering on their façades. Several women and children stand and walk in the middle of the unpaved street, one pushing a baby carriage. On the right are more ornate houses with gabled façades and a line of trees and street lamps. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century European town.
